text: {"lessons":["Selling winners felt good, but it did not prevent my overall account value from falling afterward; I should not assume a realized gain means I made the best decision.","Several months of holding without trading still brought both gains and losses, so inaction is not a way to control random price movements.","I should make each trade based on my overall portfolio and a consistent plan, not on whether a stock is above my average cost or on recent account changes."]}
